quests.title: Your Four-Week Outcome
quests.blurb: I don't need you to have a job. I need a job to have had you — four weeks, on a form. Suite 3, above the tile showroom, Reserve Road. Buzz twice. The first buzzer does nothing and I've claimed for that too.

steps.label: sit the ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred
attend the interview, one stop up the line
photograph the shopfront so the interview happened
clear $40 so the form shows commencement earnings
sign the claim, dated the Monday before last

quests.title: Photographic Evidence of the Hedge
quests.blurb: There is a hedge on Ocean Avenue that has grown four metres since the orders. I am not permitted within a hundred metres of it. Nobody knows who you are, which makes you the most useful person in the eastern suburbs.

steps.label: buy a flat white on the way through Double Bay and carry it like it is yours
walk up Ocean Avenue — there is no station, that is the whole point of the suburb — and photograph the hedge from the public footpath
someone will come out and ask what you are doing. Someone always comes out
back to Edgecliff and show him the phone

quests.title: The Harbour Bridge Rail Experience
quests.blurb: Twelve dollars. Three minutes. Unrivalled harbour views. Five more for the harbour side, and don't you dare tell them which side that is. The hard part is the photograph. I'll explain the photograph.

steps.label: round up the punters from under the face
take the fares and the harbour-side upgrade
run the crossing: one stop, facing the water
shoot the bridge from the Quay, where it fits
handle the customer who counted the stops

quests.title: Evidence of Vibrancy
quests.blurb: Category B placemaking grant. To get the money that fixes the piazza I first have to prove the piazza is already in use. Footfall, retail expenditure, a photo, one objection. You are the footfall.

steps.label: photograph the Italian Forum piazza in use. You are the use.
record one (1) instance of retail expenditure on the Norton Street dining precinct
arrive by light rail. Category B is transit-oriented, so the arrival has to be one you can evidence.
record Kevin's objection. In full, and once.

quests.title: One Short for the Triples
quests.blurb: Kev's done his hamstring at touch footy, so we're two and the constitution says three. Club's woods are in Wazza's ute at Rooty Hill. Get them, get the train back, be on the green before four.

steps.label: find Wazza's ute at Rooty Hill; the club's woods are behind the seat
ask Wazza for the bowls, then ask Wazza's apprentice, who has the keys
one stop on the train; nobody drives home from a triples
move $25 of meat raffle tickets before the draw
photograph the green for the council grant: evidence of community usage

quests.title: Four Point Six One
quests.blurb: At four point six oh the app stops opening and you find out you were never an employee. Three pings stacked, a ranger doing laps of the block, and a bloke asleep in my back seat. You've got legs. Go.

steps.label: stand where the app drops the pin: the Abercrombie Street corner, where no car has ever legally stopped
get the sleeper out of the back seat and pointed at his own street. He isn't sick, he's finished
walk the nineteen-dollar fare onto the platform and ride her the one stop she ordered a car for
clear $35 off the queue before the surge dies and it's just a Tuesday again
photograph the ticket on the windscreen in the Lawson Street bus zone. The appeal needs to see there was no bus
count the night up on the steering wheel with Bec

quests.title: Fasting Since Sunday
quests.blurb: Six-ten, and the round starts at six. Seven tubes for the Carlton rooms, one stop down the line. The courier van was booked for Sunday. Sunday isn't in the system this morning, so neither is the van.

steps.label: One flat white, no sugar, hers. The seven names on her list have fasted since Sunday and it would be rude to walk in holding seven more.
Clear the boom gate on the hospital carpark. Someone has been explaining her parking validation to a machine since ten past six and the ambulances would like through.
One stop with the esky on your lap. Not on the floor, not on the seat, not next to the bloke with the Dragons scarf. On your lap.
Photograph the docket on the counter at the Carlton rooms. Monday will say nothing arrived. The photo will say otherwise, for a while.
Back up Belgrave Street to Nell, and read her the date the docket printed.

quests.title: Blacks, No Logos
quests.blurb: Black shirt, black pants, shoes you can't see your socks through. Before a client sees you there's an assessment: a coffee, a complaint, one stop on the train, and a photo of a door in Edgecliff.

steps.label: item one: flat white, from the place by the escalators. It is timed and she can tell.
item two: the woman who reports the table to centre management every fortnight. Be persuasive.
item three: one stop to Edgecliff. Tap on. She needs the record, not the walk.
item four: photograph the client's door. Do not buzz it. They have not been told about you.

quests.title: Submission 41 to the Night-Time Economy Review
quests.blurb: DeFAULT is lodging a submission and a submission needs photographs. Two hours of your day, most of it downhill. There's no money in it. There's forty dollars in it. Don't say that in front of the branch.

steps.label: get a flat white into Tam. He does not start the working day without one and neither does the suburb.
the booze bus sets up at the bottom of Darlinghurst Road from nine. Register your feedback with it.
photograph the Downing Centre on Liverpool Street — where Oxford Street ends up on a Monday morning
train it out to Newtown. Everything that used to happen here happens on Enmore Road now, and Tam wants that in the record.
back up Darlinghurst Road and sign the statutory declaration

quests.title: Wide, Light-Filled, Close to Transport
quests.blurb: Ten-fifteen open home, forty-one registered, and the owner reckons five-twenty a week. Mate, it's a garage. It has a roller door. I need it photographing like a home before ten-fifteen.

steps.label: come out the way an applicant would — the listing says twenty-two minutes to the city, and nobody at the agency has ever checked
get down the driveway behind the block on Cabramatta Road before the couples do
shoot it from across the road, back to the wall, phone sideways — high enough that the bottle shop is out of frame
number nine tells every applicant about the mould; number nine can tell them about it Monday
show thirty dollars of income and you go to the top of the applicant list, which tells you everything
